🐻🐞 Bear & Bug • Always Side by Side

If We Have Bear, He Must Have His Bug.

When Michael was ten and Rachel was eight, someone cruel tried to make Michael ashamed of his size. Eight-year-old Rachel stepped right in front of him and rewrote the rules: he wasn’t soft—he was big, warm, and strong, and he protected her. She crowned him her Bear, and he named her his fierce little Bug because she never let go of him.

“Rachel waited years to get her driver’s license just so she and Michael could walk into the DMV together. Did anyone really think she’d let him build RaggieSoft without pulling up a second chair as his quality tester?”

Inside Rachel’s (“Bug’s”) Quality-Testing Desk

Pick a desk tab below to see what Rachel checks right beside Michael before any book, song, or interactive Crossroads path goes out the door.

📖 Reading Every Scene Out Loud Beside Bear

Before a new chapter goes live on RaggieSoft Book Reader, Rachel pulls her chair over to Michael’s desk and reads it straight through like a first-time reader.

  • Making sure every scene opens right inside the moment instead of feeling like a dry summary.
  • Checking that character ages, bus routes, seasons, and family memories line up across episodes.
  • Confirming scene illustrations match who is in the room and what they are wearing.
  • Testing Next Chapter and Table of Contents buttons so readers never hit a dead end.
